integrity: The lower bounds are symbolic integer arguments and the construction is explicit. Finite code only replays the construction and arithmetic; it is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The result is for the tournament win-count Borda rule, strict inversion after deleting the last-ranked player, repeated matches allowed, and no balanced-schedule constraint. It does not classify all extremizers or extend to other ranking methods.
title: Sharp match sparsity for Borda inversion
